messages:
nina: quick heads-up from community report : sampleapp fails on JRuby due to psych native extension load error. opened a tiny PR to add a pure-Ruby YAML fallback and tweak gemspec. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1427

ash: paste the failing trace? is it a LoadError or a parser mismatch?

nina: here's the CI snippet: ```
LoadError: cannot load such file -- psych.so
from /home/runner/.rvm/rubies/jruby-9.3.0.0/lib/ruby/site_ruby/psych.rb:12:in `require'
YAML::ParseError: (<unknown>): mapping values are not allowed here at line 1 column 5
```

ci-bot: JRuby-9.3 job failed: test-sampleapp-jruby (exit 1). Full logs: https://ci.internal/builds/10021

kai: JRuby doesn't compile the C ext; many gems handle this by falling back to the pure Ruby parser or a different library like `safe_yaml` / `yaml.rb`. Two ideas: 1) try `require 'yaml'` inside a rescue and fall back to `YAML.load` with `safe_load` defaults, 2) vendor a tiny pure-ruby parser as optional. prefer (1) to keep gem small.

nina: PR implements option (1): we wrap the config load path in `begin; require 'psych'; rescue LoadError; require 'yaml'; end` and use `YAML.safe_load` with permitted classes. also added a small helper in sampleapp to detect JRUBY and set `ENV['USE_PURE_YAML'] = '1'` in tests.

ash: nice. can we add a CI matrix job for jruby so community contributors get faster feedback? otherwise they hit surprise failures.

kai: yes please. add `matrix.ruby: jruby-9.3` to GH actions. also gate any C-extension specific specs behind an ENV like `SKIP_CEXT=true` to avoid false negatives.

nina: will add jruby matrix entry + skip gate for cext tests. also tiny CHANGELOG entry and a note in sampleapp README under "Running on JRuby/Windows" describing fallback and how to run tests locally.

release-bot: created prerelease `v2.3.1-pre` for branch `main` to run integration tests.

ci-bot: nina pushed commit 4d2a9f. CI: matrix started (ruby-3.1, ruby-2.7, jruby-9.3). logs: https://ci.internal/builds/10025

nina: tagging @kai for quick review once jruby job green. I'll also open a backport PR to the `2.x` branch after merge.

kai: happy to review. one tiny nit: prefer the helper `Redwood::Platform.jruby?` instead of ENV checks. makes test code clearer.

nina: good call, I'll switch to that helper and push.

ci-bot: jruby-9.3 job passed. all matrix jobs green. build: https://ci.internal/builds/10028

nina: merged and backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1430. added README snippet and CHANGELOG. thanks for the quick help everyone :raised_hands:

kai: great work. adding a short community post to explain the JRuby fallback and how to run sampleapp on JRuby/Windows would reduce future onboarding friction.

nina: will draft a tiny note in community repo and link it from sampleapp README. closing loop in this thread. :white_check_mark:
